description: Plcsense enables AI agents to understand your TwinCAT libraries and docs, so they write against the real API, not memory.
notes: - fix: plcsense in TwinCAT CoAgent follows the solution open in XAE
CoAgent starts its add-on servers once, often before XAE has opened the
solution, and passes --active_solution only when one was open then; it never
restarts them when the solution changes. plcsense then worked on CoAgent's own
python folder, found no .sln and did not recognise CoAgent as the host
Under CoAgent, plcsense now asks the XAE shell which solution is open, over the
local endpoint CoAgent provides to its add-ons. Before a tool call (at most every
2 s, 2 s timeout) it reads which TwinCAT projects are loaded and takes the folder
of the .sln that names one as the root. That root ranks after client roots and
before --active_solution; when XAE does not answer, the last answer stays. The
same endpoint also marks CoAgent as the host, so plcsense's Infosys lookups are
